definitions.cond-residual-both: Fast and Balanced caps from the residual-fraction rule; Premium brake stays 3.25.
definitions.cond-residual-fast: Fast cap from the residual-fraction rule; Balanced 1.45; Premium brake 3.25.
definitions.shipped: Fast 1.11, Balanced 1.45, Premium predicted cap 3.25, brake_ratio 3.25.
definitions.static-fast-1.13: Fast 1.13 on every batch; Balanced 1.45; brake 3.25. Control for whether the residual condition is necessary.

context_frozen.note: Cost heads, family-guard multipliers, runaway_fraction, count_cap, denylist and ExtraTrees stay shipped. Changing Fast cap does not re-derive runaway; serving uses the frozen 0.165.

decision_reasons.fail: No leftover-budget arm cleared the pre-registered Train gain, Dev veto, TV-ball and safety gates. Keep the current runtime.
decision_reasons.pass: A leftover-budget arm beat shipped Train official score through the serving path and survived Dev veto plus composition stress. This opens a promotion window only.

metric.definition: Official weighted final score on the full Train batch (selection) and full Dev batch (veto). Stress views replay the allocator.
metric.selection: Train official Δ versus shipped; Dev never ranks arms.

motivation.note: Quality-head search is exhausted. lock_final_policy already searched static Fast/Balanced grids with a numpy replica. E6 tests two untested leftover levers on the actual serving path: a content-only residual-fraction cap rule, and a modest Premium brake raise.
motivation.original_e5_unrun: Competitor-report E5 (Fast-first cap recovery) was never run after the later E1 chain. This protocol is that leftover question plus a composition condition so hidden residual mix can keep the shipped Fast cap.
